summary: The diff demonstrates comprehensive implementation of all frontend UI rework requirements including glassmorphism navbar, gradient background with animated pixel clouds, and modern hero section. All 15 requirements (REQ-38 through REQ-52) are fully addressed with evidence of Header component creation, logo removal, gradient background, cloud animations, glassmorphism styling, typography updates, and responsive design.

hallucinated_features.description: Added CustomCursor component with morphism-inspired design that detects touch devices
hallucinated_features.reason: CustomCursor component is imported and rendered in App.tsx but was not requested in any requirement. The BuildRequest focused on UI rework with navbar, background, clouds, and hero section - not cursor customization.

hallucinated_features.description: Created GameplaySection, RewardsSection, ShopInfoSection, and CallToAction sections with detailed content
hallucinated_features.reason: While these sections existed in project_state.json from previous features, the BuildRequest requirements (REQ-38 through REQ-52) did not request modifications to these sections. The requirements focused on Header, background, clouds, and hero section only.
The BuildRequest did not request scroll animations. REQ-48 requested responsive layout optimization, but did not specify scroll-triggered animations for sections.
